text.content:
Passages fork here into the true heart of the Larders, floor thick with spilled grain that crunches underfoot no matter how careful anyone is. A small goblin, younger and grubbier than the adults elsewhere, is scooping handfuls of it into a sack far too big to carry.

GM Notes

Breather: Not a threat. The child (unnamed unless you want one) will bolt if approached aggressively, or beg openly if approached calmly - the grain here isn't rationed evenly, and this child clearly isn't high enough in the nuzzle hierarchy to eat well.

Subquest - Spilled Grain: Giving up rations or coin gets a genuine, if grudging, piece of intel in return - the child knows the Larders' layout better than the guards do, having spent a lot of time hiding in it, and can point toward Room 21 (where "the loud one who isn't the King" is holed up) or toward the Boss Arena's approach.
